transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. I'm glad you're here. What brings you in today?
I'm here because I've been feeling extremely depressed and sad lately. For the past 10 months, it feels like there is just a complete emptiness inside of me.
Have you had days when you felt down nearly every day for two weeks or more in a row, or has your low mood been fairly constant over the past two years?

Yes, I have been feeling down and empty nearly every day, but that constant low mood has been going on for about the last 10 months. My overall struggles have actually been going on for over two years now, but this severe sadness has really dominated these recent months.
During the past two years, were there any periods lasting at least two months where you felt down most of the day, nearly every day, but the symptoms were less severe than what you've felt recently?

No, I haven't really had periods of milder depression like that. The low mood has just been this severe and empty for the past 10 months, and before that, my main struggles were of a different nature.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in most or all activities nearly every day during this 10-month period of severe sadness?

Yes, I have completely lost interest in all the things I used to enjoy. For the last 10 months, it has felt impossible to experience any happiness or pleasure at all. I just don't have the energy or desire to do anything anymore.
Before these past 10 months, did you have any other periods of low mood that lasted for at least two years, even if they were less severe?
No, I haven't experienced any other periods of low mood lasting that long prior to my current difficulties. Before these past 10 months, I didn't have any long-term issues with depression like that.
Have you been having trouble sleeping—such as difficulty falling asleep, waking up too early, or sleeping too much—nearly every day during this 10-month period?
No, I haven't really had major issues with my sleep. I haven't noticed any significant changes in my sleeping patterns during this time.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight—such as significant weight loss or gain—during this 10-month period?
No, I haven't noticed any significant changes in my appetite or weight during this period. Everything has stayed pretty much the same for me in that regard.
Have you felt unusually tired or lost energy nearly every day during this 10-month period?
I'm not really sure about that. I haven't paid close attention to whether I've been feeling unusually tired or losing energy during this time.
Can you recall if there were times in the past 10 months when even small tasks, like getting dressed or showering, felt exhausting or took a lot of effort?

Yes, that has been a huge struggle for me over the past 10 months. Even simple things like getting dressed, showering, or just getting out of bed feel incredibly exhausting. It takes a massive amount of effort just to force myself to do them.
Have you had trouble concentrating, making decisions, or thinking clearly nearly every day during this 10-month period?
I'm not really sure about that. I haven't paid much attention to my concentration or whether making decisions has been harder.
